description: Materials science + chemistry as graph-resident theory. Beyond what engineering covered (material selection, failure modes): atomic + molecular foundation. Chemistry: atomic structure, bonding, thermochemistry, kinetics, equilibrium, acids/bases, redox, electrochemistry, organic, biochemistry, analytical. Materials: crystal structures, defects (point, line, planar), diffusion, phase diagrams, strengthening mechanisms, heat treatment, polymers (chain structure, viscoelasticity, Tg), composites, ceramics, semiconductors (band theory), nanomaterials (graphene, nanotubes, quantum dots), biomaterials, characterization techniques (XRD, SEM/TEM, NMR, IR, MS), corrosion electrochemistry. The atomic + molecular layer beneath engineering.
category_inheritance: genlMt → compiler_theory + engineering. Chemistry: composition determines properties (denotational equivalence); reactions follow conservation laws (algebraic law); thermodynamics constrains spontaneity (referential transparency under second law).

concepts.name: atomic_structure_orbitals
concepts.definition: Electrons in orbitals: s (1), p (3), d (5), f (7). Quantum numbers n, l, ml, ms.
concepts.why: Foundation. Orbitals determine bonding + spectroscopy + chemistry. Quantum mechanical solution to H atom.

concepts.name: electron_configuration
concepts.definition: Filling order: 1s, 2s, 2p, 3s, 3p, 4s, 3d, 4p... (Aufbau).
concepts.why: Predicts periodic properties. Noble gases stable (full shells). Transition metals (partial d).

concepts.name: periodic_trends
concepts.definition: Atomic radius (decreases across, increases down), electronegativity, ionization energy.
concepts.why: Mendeleev's organization. Properties periodic in atomic number. Predicts reactivity + bonding.

concepts.name: ionic_bonding
concepts.definition: Electron transfer. Metal + non-metal. Coulombic attraction between ions.
concepts.why: Salts (NaCl, MgO). High melting, brittle, soluble in polar solvents. Lattice energy quantifies.

concepts.name: covalent_bonding
concepts.definition: Electron sharing. Non-metals + non-metals. Directional.
concepts.why: Molecules (H2O, CH4). Single, double, triple bonds. Polar (electronegativity difference) vs nonpolar.

concepts.name: metallic_bonding
concepts.definition: Delocalized electron sea around positive metal cores.
concepts.why: Conductive, malleable, ductile. Free electrons explain. Foundation of metal physics.

concepts.name: hydrogen_bonding
concepts.definition: N-H, O-H, F-H to electronegative atom on another molecule. 5-30 kJ/mol.
concepts.why: Water's anomalies, DNA structure, protein folding. Critical biological + materials role.

concepts.name: van_der_Waals
concepts.definition: Weak intermolecular: dispersion (London), dipole-dipole, dipole-induced.
concepts.why: Noble gases liquefy, alkanes attract. Foundation of intermolecular forces. Critical for polymers + biology.

concepts.name: VSEPR_geometry
concepts.definition: Valence Shell Electron Pair Repulsion. Predicts molecular shape from electron pairs.
concepts.why: H2O bent, CH4 tetrahedral, BF3 trigonal planar. Predicts polarity + reactivity. Foundation organic chem.

concepts.name: orbital_hybridization
concepts.definition: sp, sp², sp³ hybrid orbitals. Mix s + p for directional bonds.
concepts.why: Explains tetrahedral CH4, planar C2H4, linear C2H2. Foundation of carbon's versatility.

concepts.name: stoichiometry
concepts.definition: Quantitative relationships in chemical equations. Moles, balanced equations, limiting reagents.
concepts.why: Foundation of chemistry calculations. Reactants in correct ratios. Industrial chemistry depends on.

concepts.name: Avogadros_number
concepts.definition: 6.022 × 10²³ entities per mole. Bridges atomic + macroscopic.
concepts.why: Allows molecular calculations from mass. mol = mass / molar mass. Universal chemistry tool.

concepts.name: enthalpy_reaction
concepts.definition: ΔH = H_products - H_reactants. Negative = exothermic. Hess's law: enthalpy is state function.
concepts.why: Heat released / absorbed. Bond enthalpies estimate. Foundation of thermochemistry. Standard enthalpies tabulated.

concepts.name: entropy_chemistry
concepts.definition: Disorder. ΔS = q_rev/T. Increases for gas formation, dissolution, mixing.
concepts.why: Second-law direction. Spontaneous: ΔG < 0. Universal.

concepts.name: Gibbs_free_energy
concepts.definition: G = H - TS. ΔG < 0 spontaneous. Bridges enthalpy + entropy.
concepts.why: Predicts reaction direction + equilibrium. ΔG = -RT ln K relates to equilibrium constant. Foundation.

concepts.name: rate_law
concepts.definition: rate = k[A]^m[B]^n. Order m, n empirically determined.
concepts.why: Foundation of kinetics. Doesn't depend on stoichiometry. Determined by mechanism. Standard.

concepts.name: Arrhenius_equation
concepts.definition: k = A·exp(-Ea/RT). Activation energy temperature dependence.
concepts.why: Rate constant vs temperature. Ea from slope of ln k vs 1/T. Catalysis lowers Ea. Foundation.

concepts.name: catalysis
concepts.definition: Substance that increases rate without being consumed. Provides alternative path with lower Ea.
concepts.why: Industrial chemistry + biology (enzymes). Heterogeneous (surface) + homogeneous + enzymatic. Nobel-worthy.

concepts.name: reaction_mechanisms
concepts.definition: Step-by-step pathway. Each step is elementary; intermediates form + consume.
concepts.why: Rate-determining step controls overall rate. Foundation of mechanistic understanding. Critical for design.

concepts.name: equilibrium_constant
concepts.definition: K = Π[products]^ν / Π[reactants]^ν. At equilibrium, ratio constant at given T.
concepts.why: Foundation of equilibrium. Large K: favors products. Small K: favors reactants. ΔG = -RT ln K.

concepts.name: Le_Chatelier_principle
concepts.definition: System at equilibrium responds to perturbation by shifting to relieve.
concepts.why: Predicts equilibrium shifts: add reactant → shift to product. Heat exothermic → shift back. Industrial process control.

concepts.name: Ka_Kb_Ksp
concepts.definition: Acid (Ka), base (Kb), solubility product (Ksp) equilibrium constants.
concepts.why: Quantify acid strength, base strength, solubility. Standard tables. Foundation of solution chemistry.

concepts.name: pH_pOH
concepts.definition: pH = -log[H+]. pOH = -log[OH-]. pH + pOH = 14 in water at 25°C.
concepts.why: Foundation of acid-base chemistry. Universal measurement. Buffers, indicators, biology depend on.

concepts.name: Bronsted_acid_base
concepts.definition: Acid: proton donor. Base: proton acceptor. Conjugate pairs.
concepts.why: Standard acid-base definition for aqueous. Pairs ranked by strength. HCl strong, CH3COOH weak.

concepts.name: Lewis_acid_base
concepts.definition: Lewis acid: electron pair acceptor. Base: donor. Broader than Bronsted.
concepts.why: Includes non-proton (BF3 + NH3). Foundation of coordination chemistry + organic mechanisms.

concepts.name: buffer_solution
concepts.definition: Weak acid + conjugate base. Resists pH change on added acid/base. Henderson-Hasselbalch.
concepts.why: Biology (blood pH ~7.4), pharmaceuticals, industrial processes. Foundation of pH control.

concepts.name: oxidation_reduction
concepts.definition: Redox: electron transfer. Oxidation = lose electrons; reduction = gain. Always paired.
concepts.why: Combustion, corrosion, batteries, biology (metabolism). Foundation of electrochemistry.

concepts.name: standard_reduction_potential
concepts.definition: E° vs standard hydrogen electrode. Larger = more easily reduced.
concepts.why: Predicts spontaneity of redox. ΔE° > 0 → spontaneous. Standard tables. Foundation of electrochemistry.

concepts.name: Nernst_equation
concepts.definition: E = E° - (RT/nF)·ln Q. Concentration dependence of cell potential.
concepts.why: Real conditions (not standard). Battery voltage varies with state of charge. pH electrodes use.

concepts.name: battery_chemistry
concepts.definition: Galvanic cell. Anode oxidation, cathode reduction. Primary (non-rechargeable) vs secondary.
concepts.why: Lithium-ion (LiCoO2, LiFePO4, NMC), lead-acid, NiMH. Foundation of energy storage. Critical for EV + grid.

concepts.name: fuel_cell
concepts.definition: H2 + O2 → H2O + electricity. PEM (proton exchange membrane), SOFC (solid oxide).
concepts.why: Direct chemical-to-electric. Higher efficiency than combustion + Carnot. Hydrogen economy.

concepts.name: corrosion_electrochemistry
concepts.definition: Galvanic cell on metal surface. Iron + water + O2 → rust. Mitigation via cathodic protection.
concepts.why: Already in engineering; here at atomic level. Anode oxidizes, cathode reduces (O2 + 2H2O + 4e → 4OH).

concepts.name: functional_groups_organic
concepts.definition: -OH (alcohol), -COOH (acid), -NH2 (amine), -C=O (carbonyl), C=C (alkene), C≡C (alkyne).
concepts.why: Foundation of organic chemistry. Behaviour predictable from functional groups. Drug design, polymers, biology.

concepts.name: alkanes_alkenes_alkynes
concepts.definition: Saturated (single), unsaturated (double), triple-bonded carbons. C_nH_2n+2, C_nH_2n, C_nH_2n-2.
concepts.why: Hydrocarbons. Foundation of petrochemistry. Reactivity: alkanes inert, alkenes/alkynes add.

concepts.name: aromatic_compounds
concepts.definition: Benzene ring + derivatives. Delocalized π electrons. Resonance.
concepts.why: Pharmaceuticals, polymers, dyes. Hückel 4n+2 rule for aromaticity. Foundation of medicinal chemistry.

concepts.name: stereochemistry
concepts.definition: 3D arrangement of atoms. Chirality (R/S), cis/trans, E/Z.
concepts.why: Drugs often single enantiomer (thalidomide tragedy). Biology highly stereoselective. Critical pharmaceutical.

concepts.name: SN1_SN2_substitution
concepts.definition: Nucleophilic substitution. SN1: stepwise via carbocation. SN2: concerted, backside attack.
concepts.why: Foundation organic mechanism. Predicts product + stereochemistry. Standard teaching example.

concepts.name: polymerization_chain
concepts.definition: Monomers join. Addition (chain growth) or condensation (step growth).
concepts.why: Polyethylene, polystyrene, nylon, polyester. Foundation of polymer chemistry. Industrial scale.

concepts.name: amino_acids_proteins
concepts.definition: 20 standard amino acids. -COOH + -NH2 + side chain. Peptide bonds form proteins.
concepts.why: Foundation of biochemistry. Primary (sequence) → secondary (helix/sheet) → tertiary (3D) → quaternary.

concepts.name: DNA_RNA_structure
concepts.definition: Double helix. Sugar-phosphate backbone + bases. Complementary pairing A-T (U), G-C.
concepts.why: Genetic information. Replication, transcription, translation. Foundation of molecular biology.

concepts.name: lipids_membranes
concepts.definition: Hydrophobic + hydrophilic regions. Phospholipid bilayer = cell membrane.
concepts.why: Compartmentalization basis of life. Drug delivery (liposomes). Membrane biology.

concepts.name: enzymes
concepts.definition: Protein catalysts. Active site binds substrate. Lower Ea.
concepts.why: Biological catalysis. 10^6-10^17 rate enhancement. Specificity from active site geometry. Drug targets.

concepts.name: carbohydrates
concepts.definition: (CH2O)n. Mono (glucose, fructose), di (sucrose, lactose), poly (starch, cellulose).
concepts.why: Energy storage + structural (cellulose). Glycolysis + TCA cycle metabolism.

concepts.name: FCC_BCC_HCP_crystals
concepts.definition: Face-Centered Cubic, Body-Centered Cubic, Hexagonal Close-Packed. Metal structures.
concepts.why: FCC: Al, Cu, Au, Ag, Ni (ductile). BCC: Fe (α), Cr, W (less ductile, lower T). HCP: Mg, Zn, Ti (textured).

concepts.name: Miller_indices
concepts.definition: (hkl) for planes, [uvw] for directions. Crystallographic notation.
concepts.why: Communicates crystal directions + planes. Foundation of crystallography. XRD interpretation.

concepts.name: point_defects
concepts.definition: Vacancies, interstitials, substitutional. Always present (entropy).
concepts.why: Diffusion mechanism. Equilibrium concentration ∝ exp(-Ev/kT). Critical for semiconductor doping.

concepts.name: line_defects_dislocations
concepts.definition: Edge + screw dislocations. Slip vector (Burgers vector).
concepts.why: Plastic deformation mechanism. Dislocations glide → metal deforms. Foundation of plasticity.

concepts.name: grain_boundaries
concepts.definition: Interfaces between crystal grains. Misorientation angle. High-angle (random) vs low-angle.
concepts.why: Strengthening (Hall-Petch). Diffusion paths. Corrosion sites. Grain refinement → stronger.

concepts.name: Ficks_diffusion_laws
concepts.definition: Fick's 1st: J = -D ∂C/∂x (flux). 2nd: ∂C/∂t = D ∂²C/∂x² (time-dependent).
concepts.why: Foundation of diffusion. Heat treatment kinetics, semiconductor doping, oxidation, transport. Universal.

concepts.name: diffusion_Arrhenius
concepts.definition: D = D_0 exp(-Q/RT). Strong temperature dependence.
concepts.why: Higher T = faster diffusion. Diffusion controls many materials processes. Critical for heat treatment.

concepts.name: Fe_C_phase_diagram
concepts.definition: Iron-carbon phase diagram. α (ferrite BCC), γ (austenite FCC), Fe3C (cementite), pearlite, martensite.
concepts.why: Foundation of steel. Eutectoid at 0.77%C, 727°C. Heat treatment manipulates phases. Most studied phase diagram.

concepts.name: lever_rule
concepts.definition: In two-phase region, mass fraction = (other phase composition - average) / (composition difference).
concepts.why: Computes phase amounts from phase diagram. Standard calculation. Essential for material analysis.

concepts.name: TTT_CCT_diagrams
concepts.definition: Time-Temperature-Transformation + Continuous Cooling Transformation. Steel transformations.
concepts.why: Predicts microstructure from cooling rate. Pearlite, bainite, martensite. Foundation of steel heat treatment.

concepts.name: annealing_quenching_tempering
concepts.definition: Annealing: slow cool (soft). Quenching: rapid (martensite). Tempering: reheat quenched (toughen).
concepts.why: Already in engineering; here at mechanism level. Phase transformations drive properties. Standard steel processing.

concepts.name: precipitation_hardening
concepts.definition: Heat to dissolve, quench to supersaturate, age to precipitate. Coherent precipitates strengthen.
concepts.why: Aluminium alloys (2024, 7075). Strength via precipitates impeding dislocations. Standard aerospace.

concepts.name: work_hardening
concepts.definition: Plastic deformation increases dislocation density → harder + stronger but less ductile.
concepts.why: Cold rolling, drawing. Standard strengthening. Recovered by annealing. Foundation of metal forming.

concepts.name: solid_solution_strengthening
concepts.definition: Alloying atoms distort lattice → impede dislocation motion.
concepts.why: Pure metals soft. Brass (Cu+Zn), bronze (Cu+Sn). Foundation of alloy strengthening.

concepts.name: grain_refinement_Hall_Petch
concepts.definition: σ_y = σ_0 + k·d^(-1/2). Smaller grains = stronger.
concepts.why: Grain boundaries block dislocations. Strengthening + improved toughness + improved corrosion. Standard.

concepts.name: polymer_glass_transition
concepts.definition: Tg: temperature where polymer transitions from glassy to rubbery.
concepts.why: Critical polymer property. Above Tg: flexible. Below: brittle. Tunable via plasticizers. Polymer design.

concepts.name: polymer_crystallinity
concepts.definition: Polymers can be amorphous or partly crystalline. Crystallinity affects strength + transparency.
concepts.why: HDPE crystalline, LDPE branched + amorphous. Strength + barrier from crystallinity. Foundation polymer properties.

concepts.name: polymer_viscoelasticity
concepts.definition: Behaves elastically + viscously. Creep under sustained load. Frequency-dependent response.
concepts.why: Polymers vs metals. Foundation of polymer mechanical design. Stress relaxation important.

concepts.name: molecular_weight_distribution
concepts.definition: Mn (number average), Mw (weight average), PDI = Mw/Mn dispersity.
concepts.why: Polymer properties depend on MW + distribution. Synthesis control. Narrow distribution = better.

concepts.name: composites_matrix_reinforcement
concepts.definition: Matrix (polymer, metal, ceramic) + reinforcement (fibers, particles). Combine properties.
concepts.why: Already in engineering; here at mechanism. Rule of mixtures predicts properties. Foundation.

concepts.name: composite_lay_up
concepts.definition: Stacking sequence of unidirectional plies. [0°/90°/±45°] common.
concepts.why: Tailored properties. Carbon fibre orientation = strength direction. Aerospace design fundamental.

concepts.name: ceramic_processing
concepts.definition: Powder + binder → green body → sinter. Densification by atomic diffusion.
concepts.why: Foundation of ceramic manufacturing. Different from metals (melting) or polymers (molding). Specialized.

concepts.name: band_theory_semiconductors
concepts.definition: Valence band + conduction band + bandgap. Metals: overlap. Insulators: wide gap. Semiconductors: small.
concepts.why: Foundation of electronic materials. Si gap 1.1 eV; GaAs 1.4. Predicts conductivity + light absorption.

concepts.name: doping_p_n
concepts.definition: Add impurities. p-type: less valence electron (B in Si). n-type: more (P in Si).
concepts.why: Foundation of transistors + diodes. Controls Fermi level. Modern electronics.

concepts.name: pn_junction
concepts.definition: p-type + n-type contact. Built-in voltage. Diode behaviour.
concepts.why: Foundation of all semiconductor devices. Solar cells, LEDs, transistors. The element.

concepts.name: graphene
concepts.definition: Single layer of carbon atoms in hexagonal lattice. ~200x stronger than steel.
concepts.why: Nobel 2010. Electrical + mechanical + thermal extreme. Research → applications: composites, electronics.

concepts.name: carbon_nanotubes
concepts.definition: Rolled graphene sheets. Single-wall (SWCNT) or multi-wall. Metallic or semiconducting depending on chirality.
concepts.why: Strong, conductive. Composites, electronics, biomedical. Production scaling.

concepts.name: quantum_dots
concepts.definition: Nanometer semiconductor crystals. Quantum confinement → tunable emission by size.
concepts.why: Displays (Samsung QLED), bio-imaging, solar. Tunable by chemistry. Nobel 2023.

concepts.name: nanoparticles_synthesis
concepts.definition: Sub-100 nm. Top-down (milling) or bottom-up (solution, vapor).
concepts.why: Catalysis, drug delivery, sensors. Surface-to-volume ratio drives unique properties.

concepts.name: XRD_x_ray_diffraction
concepts.definition: Bragg: nλ = 2d sin θ. X-rays diffract from crystal planes.
concepts.why: Standard structural characterisation. Identify phases, lattice parameters, crystallinity. Foundation of crystallography.

concepts.name: SEM_TEM_imaging
concepts.definition: Scanning Electron Microscopy: surface. Transmission EM: thin section, atomic resolution.
concepts.why: Imaging nanostructures. SEM: nm-μm features. TEM: atomic resolution. Standard for materials characterization.

concepts.name: AFM_atomic_force
concepts.definition: Atomic Force Microscopy. Probe scans surface; topography from deflection.
concepts.why: Surface roughness, thin films, biology. Atomic resolution in vacuum. Versatile.

concepts.name: NMR_spectroscopy
concepts.definition: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance. ¹H, ¹³C nuclei in magnetic field. Chemical shift identifies environment.
concepts.why: Standard organic chemistry. Connectivity + structure determination. Foundation of structural analysis.

concepts.name: IR_spectroscopy
concepts.definition: Infrared. Molecular vibrations absorb at characteristic frequencies. Functional group identification.
concepts.why: Quick functional group ID. C=O at ~1700 cm⁻¹, O-H broad. Standard chemistry analytical.

concepts.name: mass_spectrometry
concepts.definition: Ionise + separate by m/z. Identifies molecular weight + structure.
concepts.why: Universal: drug discovery, environmental, forensics. Tandem MS for structure. Ultra-sensitive.

concepts.name: chromatography_HPLC_GC
concepts.definition: Separate mixtures. HPLC (liquid), GC (gas). Stationary + mobile phase.
concepts.why: Standard analytical. Purity, identification, quantification. Industrial + research.

rules.name: atomic_structure_determines_chemistry
rules.why: Valence electrons = bonding. Periodic table organised by configuration. Mendeleev's insight: properties periodic. Foundation.

rules.name: bonding_type_determines_properties
rules.why: Ionic: high melt, brittle, polar-soluble. Covalent: variable. Metallic: conductive, ductile. Van der Waals: low melt. Universal.

rules.name: Gibbs_free_energy_predicts_spontaneity
rules.why: G = H - TS. Captures enthalpy + entropy. Kinetics may slow but doesn't change spontaneity. Foundation thermo.

rules.name: Arrhenius_doubling_per_10K
if: temperature increases ~10 K near room temp
rules.why: k = A exp(-Ea/RT). For Ea ~50 kJ/mol: 10K change → ~2x. Standard rule of thumb. Cool to slow, warm to speed.

rules.name: Le_Chatelier_predicts_shift_direction
rules.why: Add reactant: shift to products. Increase T (exothermic): shift back. Universal qualitative prediction.

rules.name: catalysts_lower_Ea
then: reaction rate increases without altering equilibrium
rules.why: Alternative path with lower Ea. Both forward + reverse rates increase equally. Equilibrium unchanged. Foundation.

rules.name: redox_drives_electrochemistry
rules.why: Galvanic cell. ΔG = -nFΔE. Battery foundation. Negative ΔE° = electrolysis required. Universal.

rules.name: chirality_critical_pharmaceuticals
then: enantiomers may have different biological effects
rules.why: Thalidomide tragedy. Single enantiomer drugs (esomeprazole). FDA increasingly requires enantiopure. Foundation pharmaceutical.

rules.name: amino_acid_sequence_determines_protein_structure
rules.why: Anfinsen's dogma. AlphaFold validates with high accuracy. Foundation of structural biology. Drug design depends on.

rules.name: FCC_more_ductile_than_BCC
then: typically more ductile than BCC at low temperatures
rules.why: FCC has 12 slip systems active at any T. BCC: 12 systems but harder to activate at low T. Steel ductile-brittle transition.

rules.name: dislocations_carry_plastic_deformation
rules.why: Atomic bonds break + reform along dislocation. Far easier than rigid lattice shear. Foundation of plasticity since 1934.

rules.name: Hall_Petch_smaller_grains_stronger
rules.why: Grain boundaries impede dislocation motion. More boundaries (smaller grains) = stronger. Standard strengthening mechanism.

rules.name: diffusion_dominates_high_T_processes
if: material is at high homologous temperature
rules.why: D = D_0 exp(-Q/RT). At T > 0.5 T_melt: diffusion rapid. Determines material processing + service life.

rules.name: quenching_traps_high_T_phase
if: material cooled rapidly from high T
then: high-T phase or supersaturated solution retained
rules.why: Diffusion needs time. Rapid cool: no time. Steel martensite, aluminium solid solution. Foundation of heat treatment.

rules.name: precipitation_hardening_via_coherent_precipitates
rules.why: Al alloys, Ni superalloys. Precipitates impede dislocations. Aging time + T controls precipitate size. Standard.

rules.name: Tg_below_service_T_for_rubber
if: polymer must be elastic at service T
rules.why: Below Tg: glassy + brittle. Above: rubbery. Tyres (NR/SBR): Tg ~-60°C. Plastic chairs (PS): Tg ~100°C, brittle at room.

rules.name: composite_properties_rule_of_mixtures
if: composite has aligned fibres in matrix
rules.why: E_c = V_f·E_f + V_m·E_m for stiffness along fibres. Standard composite design. Transverse: more complex (Halpin-Tsai).

rules.name: bandgap_determines_semiconductor_use
rules.why: Si (1.1 eV): general electronics. GaN (3.4): power, blue LEDs. GaAs (1.4): solar, infrared. SiC (3.3): high power.

rules.name: doping_controls_carrier_concentration
rules.why: All dopants ionised. Foundation of transistor design. From 10¹⁵ (lightly doped) to 10²⁰/cm³ (heavily). Critical for devices.

rules.name: quantum_confinement_tunes_emission
rules.why: Particle in box: E ∝ 1/L². Smaller QD = bluer emission. Foundation of QD display technology. Size-tunable colour.

rules.name: XRD_identifies_crystal_phases
rules.why: Each phase has fingerprint diffraction pattern. PDF database has 200K+. Standard phase ID. Foundation of materials analysis.

rules.name: NMR_identifies_organic_structure
if: ¹H + ¹³C NMR run on unknown compound
rules.why: Chemical shift, multiplicity, integration give H count + environment + connectivity. Standard structure determination. Foundation.

rules.name: mass_spec_gives_molecular_formula
then: molecular formula determined from exact mass
rules.why: C, H, N, O, S have distinct exact masses. ppm accuracy → unique formula. Standard. Confirmed by isotope pattern.
